## ✅ UX & Accessibility Checklist
- [ ] **Semantic HTML**: Using correct elements for their purpose?
- [ ] **ARIA Labels**: Are icon-only buttons or interactive elements labeled?
- [ ] **Keyboard Navigation**: Can all features be accessed via keyboard?
- [ ] **Color Contrast**: Does text meet accessibility standards?
- [ ] **Focus States**: Are interactive elements clearly highlighted on focus?
